REPRESENTATIVES

FOURTH DISTRICT

ROBERT B. ADERHOLT, Republican, of Haleyville, AL; born in Haleyville, AL,
July 22, 1965; education: B.S., history and political science, Birmingham-
Southern University, Birmingham, AL; J.D., Cumberland School of Law,
Samford University, Birmingham, AL; professional history: attorney;
assistant legal advisor to Governor Fob James, 1995-96; municipal judge,
Haleyville, 1992-96; George Bush delegate, Republican National Convention,
1992; election history: elected to the 105th Congress on November 5, 1996;
reelected to each succeeding Congress.

                          Congressional Office
                       https://aderholt.house.gov

272 Cannon House Office Building, Washington, DC          (202) 225-4876
